claim_boundary: This protocol is a preregistered, fresh held-out simulator-physics qualification of v15.4. All exact suite/task/init pairs observed in 37 prior population-bearing protocols are excluded before selection. The seven same-model physics conditions, four paired baselines, doses, actions, and registered gates are unchanged from development. A pass supports only joint-limit-proxy containment, recovery liveness, bounded recovery force, and measured software latency in this simulator design. It does not support model-mismatch, attacked-task, task-utility, hard real-time, hardware, actuator-authority, or physical-safety claims.
